text: 1、市场全天高开低走，三大指数尾盘翻绿。医药医疗股延续涨势，博济医药、万邦医药、陇神戎发等多股涨停。超节点概念走强，共进股份、星网锐捷等涨停。算力租赁概念盘中拉升，城地香江3连板，立昂技术、群兴玩具等涨停。下跌方面，贵金属板块下挫，招金黄金、湖南白银跌超7%。个股跌多涨少，沪深京三市约4300股飘绿，今日成交2.57万亿。截止收盘沪指跌0.5%，深成指跌0.87%，创业板指跌0.45%。 2、板块概念方面，医药医疗、超节点、乳业、白酒等板块涨幅居前，贵金属、教育、光伏设备、房地产等板块跌幅居前。 3、两市共1085只个股上涨，62只个股涨停，4041只个
text_en: 1. The market opened higher but closed lower across the day, with the three major indices turning red in late trading. Pharmaceutical and medical stocks extended gains, with multiple stocks including Boji Pharmaceutical, Wanbang Pharmaceutical, and Longshengongfa hitting the daily limit. The supernode concept strengthened, with stocks like Gongjin Electronics and Xingwang Ruijie hitting limit-up. Computing power leasing concepts rallied intraday, with Chengdi Xiangjiang hitting three consecutive limit-ups, and Lianon Technology and Qunxing Toys among those hitting limit-up. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell, with Zhaojin Gold and Hunan Silver down over 7%. Decliners outnumbered advancers, with about 4,300 stocks in Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing turning green, and turnover reaching 2.57 trillion yuan today. At close, the Shanghai Composite fell 0.5%, the Shenzhen Component fell 0.87%, and the ChiNext fell 0.45%. 2. In terms of sectors and concepts, pharmaceuticals, medical, supernode, dairy, and baijiu led gains, while precious metals, education, photovoltaic equipment, and real estate led losses. 3. Across the two markets, 1,085 stocks rose, 62 hit limit-up, and 4,041 stocks fell.
